purpose: test within-species information-history and reversal, not full interaction-network hysteresis
anti_overfit_rules: do not use the published 2008 arrival-breeding reversal to choose an information changepoint
do not inspect arrival-breeding interval before the information-regime algorithm is frozen and run
do not choose climate-window definitions by their association with the PAYOFF-B response
if archived source-defined climate covariates are available, use their published definitions unchanged
if source-defined annual climate covariates are unavailable, stop as NOT_ESTIMABLE rather than select a new window from outcome fit

primary_information_coordinate.predictor: published African temperature cue available before or during spring migration
primary_information_coordinate.processing: separately detrend predictor and target on year within each trailing window, then Pearson correlate residuals

regime_detection.algorithm: single-break segmented least squares over all eligible interior years, selecting the breakpoint minimizing connectivity SSE
regime_detection.null_comparator: single linear trend in predictive connectivity
regime_detection.break_gate: segmented model must improve AICc by >= 4 over linear trend
recovery_gate: post-break connectivity slope must have opposite sign to pre-break slope
absolute post-break endpoint connectivity must recover at least 50% of the pre-break-to-break decline
regime_detection.no_regime_outcome: if gates fail, classify NO_INFORMATION_REVERSAL and do not fit a hysteresis model

timing_outcome.primary: annual mean male calculated arrival-to-egg-laying interval
timing_outcome.published_2008_break: external comparison only; never used to define regime

hysteresis_test_if_information_reversal_.regime_direction: degradation versus recovery arm defined solely from connectivity breakpoint
hysteresis_test_if_information_reversal_.hysteresis_support_rule: interaction 95% CI excludes zero and predicted timing interval differs between degradation and recovery arms at the overlapping middle 50% of connectivity support
hysteresis_test_if_information_reversal_.stronger_state_memory_rule: at matched connectivity, recovery-arm predicted interval remains shifted in the historical direction by >= 2 days with 95% CI excluding zero
hysteresis_test_if_information_reversal_.null_rule: otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED; do not retune breakpoint, connectivity window or outcome

interpretation_ceiling: this lane is within-species information-history, not interaction-network memory because partner timing is absent
a supported path-dependence interaction would motivate, not prove, the full network-hysteresis mechanism
published nonlinear interval reversal around 2008 is not itself evidence for information hysteresis
